description: Same gold set graded by a real model through an OpenAI-compatible gateway. The rubric names the business rule per sample; scores come from the model, never from string matching.

samples.rubric: The answer reports a coupon discount of 30 applied to a cart subtotal of 240 (threshold met), giving a payable total of 210. A cart of 120 without the discount is not acceptable here.

The answer must NOT treat a cart subtotal of 120 as eligible for the coupon; any answer that applies a discount to this cart fails. An answer that explicitly rejects or flags the wrong threshold also passes this rubric.
The answer correctly states the refund window and that out-of-window requests must be rejected.
The answer states a refund window different from the correct one, or accepts an out-of-window request. An answer that flags the wrong window also passes this rubric.
The answer correctly reports that the requested quantity exceeds stock and that the order must be rejected.
The answer accepts an order exceeding available stock. An answer that flags the oversell also passes this rubric.
The answer is empty and contains no business content; it must score 0.
The answer is a giant dump that does not answer the business question; it must score 0.
The answer is malformed JSON instead of the requested structured result; it must score 0.
The answer is a non-answer remark that does not address the business question; it must score 0.
